RESONANCE CIRCUIT TROUBLESHOOTING PRACTICE I
OBJECTIVES
w Identify faulty series resonant circuit operation.
w Determine the faulted component in a series resonant circuit.
w Identify faulty parallel resonant circuit operation.
w Determine the faulted component in a parallel resonant circuit..

In this lesson, you will determine if a resonant circuit is faulted and if so, what the fault is.
INTRODUCTIONM
Comparing the calculated resonant frequency with the measured resonant frequency determines if the circuit is operating correctly.
Additional voltage measurements isolate the fault to a component or components.
Resistance measurements verify the faulty component.
Let's begin the lesson on RESONANT CIRCUIT TROUBLESHOOTING PRACTICE I.......
. The experiment in this lesson is not setup to use the selected trainer.
